description: Case-law precedent search (CourtListener, US) — Finds US court opinions most on point for a legal question or fact pattern: searches CourtListener's case-law index (optionally limited to courts and filing dates), reads the top opinions, and returns the best matches with a holding passage verified verbatim against the opinion text, plus citation, court, date, precedential status and a source hash. A second skeptical pass flags matches that look

courts.description: CourtListener court ids such as "scotus", "ca9", "cal", "calctapp". Omit to search all courts.

include_excerpts.description: Default true. When false, the holding passage text is omitted from the output (quote_verified and quote_offset are still reported).

question.description: The legal issue and key facts. Quote a phrase to require it verbatim in the search.

name: precedent-search
